function.name: read
function.description: Read a file (or a line range). Files only, not directories. List a directory with shell ls or find. Line numbers are added.

file.description: Path relative to the project folder.

range.description: Optional lines. 5, 1:10, 10:$, -5:$. $ is the last line.

function.name: shell
function.description: Run a command in the project root. ls/find to list, grep to search. Do not cd to the root. Pipes and && are allowed. Redirects are not. stderr is captured.

command.description: The command. Paths are relative to the project. No >, >>, <, or 2>&1.

function.name: finish
function.description: Call when you have the answer. result is stored on the task and is the only text the next agent sees.

function.name: answer
function.description: Answer the user. Call this when you can answer. Otherwise create one smaller task.

function.name: review
function.description: Verdict for this finished task. pass if the goal was done, fail if not. On pass the coder result is kept.

result.description: Short conclusion. On fail, what was done and what is missing.

notes.description: Facts to keep on this item. Empty if none.

function.name: create_task
function.description: Add one smaller task that helps answer the user. title is a few words for the plan. The goal is that task, never the whole user task. notes carry the previous report. The top passes agent orchestrator. A nested orchestrator passes manager. A manager passes coder. Fails if a step is already pending or running. A task cannot be changed after it is created.

title.description: A few words for the plan.

goal.description: This task only. Never the whole user task.

notes.description: The previous report and what this step must return. The child sees only this and its goal.

agent.description: Top orchestrator passes orchestrator. A phase orchestrator passes manager. A manager passes coder.

tools.description: Evidence, the problem, and the list of changes: read and shell. The change to one known file: read, shell, and edit. The check: read and shell.

function.name: plan
function.description: action=status shows this branch. action=write and action=update are refused. Create the next step with create_task.

function.name: notes
function.description: Refused. Notes are set in create_task and are not changed later.

function.name: edit
function.description: Replace old_text with new_text. Empty old_text inserts at the start. Match is per line after whitespace is collapsed. old_text must occur once unless multi is true. Do not include line numbers from read.

function.name: write
function.description: Create a new file. Fails if it exists. Change an existing file with edit.

function.name: send_image
function.description: Send an image so you can see it.

function.name: skill
function.description: Agent Skills from SKILL.md. action: list, status, load, unload.

function.name: mcp
function.description: MCP servers from .tai. action: status, connect, disconnect, list_tools, call.
